translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús ibmar-gwag-diglegedgi burbar sunmaksad
A-ibagi Jesús-neg-yagi-sii nodgua, mata-dummad-gakase nade-gusad, geb agi sigdap.
Agi dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad. Jesús urgi nakwisgu, agi sigis dulemar-odurdakegar, ar dulemardi bela mata-dummad-gakagi ambikusmalad.
Jesús bukidar ibmar-burbarmaladgi akar-akar dulemarga sunmaksii-gusad, dulemar-odurdaksii-gusad. Geb Jesús sogde-gusad: “Ibagwengine dule-wargwen-ibmar-gwag-digedi, ibmar-gwag dignaded.
Ibmar-gwag dignaigusgu, abala ibmar-gwag igargi babatidapid. Sikwimar nonigua, ibmar-gwag-igargi-babatismalad manonimalad.
“Abala akwa-yaisulidgi babatismalad napa-askinnegwadgi. Ar agi gwae-gwae ibmar-gwag ainialid, ar ade napa askinnegwad.
Dad gaargu, ibmar-gwag gummakded, ar ade e-maligan askinnesoggu, dinguded.
“Abala ibmar-gwag iko-abargi babatisad. Ibmar-gwag dungudgu, ikomar ibmar-gwag ichosad, degisoggu, gwen sanmaksasursundo.
“Ar ibmar-gwag-napa-nuedgi-babatismaladdi, adi nue sanmaksad. Gwenna-gwenna akusaar sanmaksad, baiddi bur-nuegwad sanmaksad, degi, baigandi bur-napiragwad sanmaksad.”
Geb Jesús sogdebar: “Bemar mag nue itobiele, nue itomar, an bemarga ibmar soged.”
¿Ibiga-wede Jesús burbar sunmakde-dae?
Geb degi e-sapingan Jesússe nonimargu, ega sogdemar: —¿Ar ibiga be dulemarga burbar ibmar sog-dae?
Jesús, abin-imakdegu sogde: “Ar bemargardi Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid igar-burbar-mamaid osanalogoye maid, ar dule-baigangardi ega osanalegosulid.
Ar dule-ibmar-nikadga, uklebalodo, adi bur-bule ibmar gatik nikuegar. Ar dule-ibmar-suliddina, ar bipii-wis-ibmar-nikad aka bur e-annik sulegoed. We sogledo, bemardi bur-bule ibmar mag-ito-guoye.
A-ular we-dulemarga burbar an sunmak-daed:
Ar degisoggu, igi epenne Isaías Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbegedi sogsa-gusa, ar deyob gunonisundo, deun sogsa-gusgu:

content.text: Ar adi mer na e-ibyagi mag dakmalagar,
degi, mer na e-uayagi mag itomalagar.

content: “Ar bemar-ibya mag dakedba, degi, bemar-uaya mag itogedba, bemardi nued begi binsalesadmalad.

Ar napira an bemarga soged, bukidar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad, degi, bukidar dule-inikii-ibmar-imakmalad, emi-bemar-ibmar-daked dakbi gusmalanad, amar gwen daksasurmalad, degi, emi-bemar-ibmar-itoged itobi gusmalanad, amar gwen itossurmalad.”
Jesús ibmar-gwag-digedgi-burbar-sunmaksad odulosad
Jesús sogdebar: “Emi bemar nue itomarsun, ibmar-gwag-digedgi burbar an-bemarga-sunmaksad-igar:
Ar dule-wargwen Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itosad, aku-ito-dibe, nia-saila nonikogua, a-dule-gwagegi gaya-burba-nued-diglesad ei ungenonikodo. Ar we sogledo, we ibmar-gwag igargi diglesadye.
“Ar ibmar-gwag-akwa-imbaba-babatismaladdi, adi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itosmargu, nue weligwar abingasmalad.

Ar wemar unnila askinbi Bab-abingasmarsoggu, ibmar-gwag-digaled maligan-askinnegwadyobdo. Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-ular wilearmargu, degine, dulemar sabsur e-imakarmargu, Bab Dummadgi bangudmalad.

“Ar ikomar-abargi-batismaladdi, we-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba abingasmalando, ar we-napneggi-ibmar-nanaidgi, degi, maniginbi bur binsamarsoggu, binsaed-galedmalad, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-e-gwagegi-naid iedmarsunnad. Degisoggu, amar ibmar-gwag gwen sanmaksasulidyob gunonisundo.

“Ar ibmar-gwag-napa-nuedgi-diglesmaladdi, we-dulemardi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itosmargu, magasar nue itosmalad. Degisoggu, amar ibmar-gwag nue sanmaksamaladyob gunonisundo. Abala bur-napiragwad sanmaksamalad, abala bur-nuegwad sanmaksamalad, degine, baigandi bur-akusaar sanmaksamardo.”
Jesús burbar gagan-iskanagi sunmaksad
Jesús burbar dulemarga sunmakdebar, sogdebar: “Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid-e-gaya-burba, dule-wargwen na e-nainugi ibmar-gwag-nued digsayobdo.
Ar dulemar gabidmargu, e-istarad orosgiid-digaled-abargi gagan-iskana dignonimogad, geb degi nadsunnad.
“Ibmar-gwag nue aramaksagu, sanmakargu, gagan-iskana-abargi daklearmogad.
“Ar e-maigan nainu-ibedse nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: ‘Dummad, ¿ar be-nainugi ibmar-gwag-nued be digsasursi? ¿Ar degite, bia we-gagan-iskanamar danisunna?’
Nainu-ibed, abin-imakdesun: ‘An-istarad we-gagan-iskana digsad.’ E-maigan, abin-imakdemar: ‘¿Anmar we-gagan-iskana ungenabi be abege?’
“Nainu-ibed, abin-sogde: ‘Suli, mer be ungenamar, ar abakalegi gagan-iskana bemar ungenaidgi orosgii-dakleged ungiarbalile.

Bur ebobela itoba na dungumaimaloed, ibmar-gwag-weleged-ibaganse. A-ibagangi ibmar-gwag-wemaladga an sogoed, bina gagan-iskana-inse be wemargwerye, amar danar-danar edinmarye, ogumakegar, orosgii-daklegeddi an-ibmar-gwag-urbilegedse be urbenamaloye.’ ”
Jesús burbar mostaza-e-gwaggi sunmaksad
Jesús baid igar-burbar-sunmaklegedgi sunmakdebar, sogdebar: “Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid-igar emi mostaza-e-gwag dule-wargwen na e-nainugi digsayobdo.
Ar mostaza-gwagde ibmar-gwagba bur-bipii-inigwele, ar dunguderdi, ibmar-dubaled-masga-gued-birgi obite-daed. Degisoggu, ar sapiga gunonikogu, sikwimar-niba-gukudimalad sunna e-anagangi gabsundo.”
Jesús burbar madubur-inagi sunmaksad

Jesús burbar-sunmakleged-igargi sunmakdebar, sogdebar: “Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid-igar weyobdo, ar igi ome-wargwen ilapaa-madubur-wilubsaedgi, madubur-ina obatisa, geb degi madubur-ina binna-binna madubur ganoni-daed, bela omuedse.”
Ibiga Jesús burbar-sunmakleged-igargi sunmakde-dae
Ar bela Jesús burbar-sunmaklegedgi dulemarga sunmakde-daed, burbar-sunmaksuli gwen gussulid.
Ar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged sogsa-gusadba guegala, deyob Jesús sunmak-gusdo, deun sogsa-gusgu:
Jesús burbar-gagan-iskanagi-sunmaksad osanalosad
Geb degi dulemar Jesúsgi bangudgua, Jesús neg-yaba dogdesun. E-sapingan Jesússe walik gunonimargu, ega sogdemalad: —Anmarga be odulo, we ibi obare, gagan-iskanagi burbar be anmarga sunmaksad.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogde: “Dule-ibmar-gwag-nued-digedi, we Dule-Machido.
Nainu-obaredi we-napnegdo, ibmar-gwag-nuedi, we Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid-e-mimmigando, gagan-iskanadi, we nia-saila-e-mimmigando.
Ar dule-istarad-gagan-iskana-digsadi we nia-sailado, ibmar-gwag-weleged-ibagan, we-napneg-berguoed-ibagando. Dulemar-ibmar-gwag-wemaladi, we angermardo.
“Ar igi gagan-iskana unnulege, degi, ogumaklege, deyobi we-napneg-berguedse guoed.
Ar Dule-Machi na e-angermar-barmidagoed, na e-neg-dakmaidgi dulemar-ibmar-ichodimalad, degi, ibmar-iskana-imakdimalad-wenonikoed,
soo-sailase ogumaknaega, ar agi amar bobukwa, degi, beedse-wilebukwadba nugar-ogorbukwa-gumaloed.
Geb degi dule-ibmar-inikii-imakmalad e-Bab-neg-dakmaidgi dad-ibeler-gaeyob mag daklenonikoed dule-nuegan-sunnad-gumalad. Ar dulemar uaya-itogega-nikmalad nue itomar an-ibmar-sogsad.”
Jesús or-nuegan-gargerbad-odukuar-siidgi sunmaksad

Jesús sogdebar: “Aginbali, Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaiddi or-nuegan nainugi odukuar bukwadyobdo. Dule-wargwen a-or-nuegan amisgu, gannar odukusad. Na weligwar-ito naogua, bela na ibmar-nikadi ukogua, a-nainu na bakoed, adi a-or-nuegan na egadga guegar.”
Jesús burbar morbeb-akwagiid-nuedgi sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebar: “Amba Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid, dule-wargwen-ibmar-baked, morbeb-akwagiid-nuegan amidiidyobdo.
Ar morbeb-akwagiid-bur-nued amisgua, nade-gusad. Na ibmar-nikad bela uksagu, ar a-morbeb-akwagiid-bur-nued baksasunnad.”
Jesús burbar sakigi sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebar: “Amba deyobbardo, Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid sakiyobdo. Saki demargi miledogu, bela galagwensuli uamar egi galeged.
Saki ua-ena-gusale, demar-gakase saki seledogu, dulemar ambikumalogu, uamar-nuegan garbagi-urbega suledagoed, uamar-iskanadi miledoed.
“Ar debayobi we-napneg berguedse guoed. Angermar ainidogu, nonimaloed, dulemar igar-maidba-inikii-ibmar-imakmalad, degi, dulemar-iskana akar-akar bachik urbegar.
Dulemar-iskana soo-sailase miledmaloed, ar agi amar bobukwa, degi, beedse-wilebukwadba nugar ogorbukwa-gumaloed.”
Ibmar-binid, degi, epennemalad ono-daedgi Jesús sunmaksad
Jesús geb e-sapinganga sogdesun: —¿Ar bela Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidgi an-bega-sogsamalad mag be itomala? Jesús-abin, sogdemar: —Eye, Dummad, bela mag an itomar.

Geb degi Jesús amarga sogdesun: —Ar a-ulale, escriba-wargwen bela Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid-igar nue wisile, bab-na-neg-yaur-sediid-wargwenyobdo, igi we-dule na e-ibmar-nuedgi ibmar-binigan, degi, ibmar-sergan, ono-dae, deyobmodo, we-dule-nue-igar-wisid, ibmar-epenne-durdaksad, degine, ibmar-bini-durdaksad ebumodo baigan-odurdakega.
Jesús Nazaretgi gudigusad
Jesús igar-burbamaladgi-sunmaksiid bergusad-sorba, nade-gusad.

Jesús na e-dungued-neggweburse nonigu, Judiomar-onmaked-neggi emar-odurdaksigisad. Bukidar agi geger dakdemalad, sogdemalad: —¿Ar wede, bia binsaed-nuegan ami-dae, degine, ibiga nabir wede ibmar-dakledisurmalad imak-dae?
¿Ar wede carpinter-e-machisursi? ¿Ar e-nande María-nugsursi, Santiago, José, Simón, degine, Judas, amarde e-urbamarsursi?
¿Ar bela-e-bunmarde anmar-abargi gudisursi? ¿Ar degite, wede bia we ibmarmar durdaksasunna?

Degisoggu, a-ular dulemar geger Jesús-dakdemalad, Jesúsgi uludmarsunnad. Ar Jesúsdi amarga sogde: —Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbemalad bela-neggwebur-baigangi bina nue sogdamalad, unnila e-neggweburginbi, degi, e-neg-yaurginmaladbi baisur dakdamalad. A-ulale bemar an-abingassurmarmogad.
Degisoggu, a-ulale, Nazaretgi Jesús ibmar-dakledisurmalad dogdar gwen imaksasulid, ar ade bukidar egi benmalad.
